summary.short: Interim final rule amending the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), effective 2 December 2024, adding foreign direct product rules, license requirements and exceptions for advanced-node chip manufacturing equipment, high-bandwidth memory and software keys. Obligations fall on exporters, reexporters and transferors.
summary.long: Interim final rule amending the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), effective 2 December 2024. It adds two foreign direct product (FDP) rules in § 734.9 covering foreign-produced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and items for Entity List Footnote 5 entities, with de minimis provisions and license requirements in § 744.11. It adds ECCN 3A090.c, controlling high-bandwidth memory above a stated memory bandwidth density, together with a License Exception HBM that requires reporting of discrepancies. It adds a License Exception Restricted Fabrication Facility (RFF) with 45-day pre-shipment notifications, installation reports and annual end-use confirmations. It adds eight Red Flags to supplement no. 3 to part 732, redefines advanced-node DRAM integrated circuits, extends § 744.23 end-use controls, and provides that software license keys follow the controls of the software or hardware they unlock. Some changes have compliance dates of 2 or 31 December 2024, and comments were due 31 January 2025.

notes: Annotated from the interim final rule FR Doc. 2024-28270 (RIN 0694-AJ74, 89 FR 96790): preamble and amendatory text for 15 CFR parts 732, 734, 736, 740, 742, 744, 758, 762, 770, 772 and 774. The fetched file also contains the preamble of the concurrent Entity List rule (RIN 0694-AJ77), a separate instrument; its dates, entities and the 140 added entities are not coded here. Footnote 5 designations are made in that companion rule, not in this text. ECCNs 3A090, 3B001, 3B002, 3B991, 3B992, 3D001, 3D002 and 3E001 are revised in full, so their unchanged parameters appear in the regulatory text and are coded as thresholds. Unit: the advanced-node DRAM memory cell area appears as '0.0019 mm2' in the extracted text; the preamble gives 'square micrometers (mm2)', so the unit is square micrometers (a lost µ in PDF extraction). Dates: the rule is effective 2 December 2024, with compliance dates of 2 or 31 December 2024 by amendatory instruction. The amendatory instruction lists skip labels (742.6 runs a., c.; part 774 lists b. after e.). ECRA's enactment in the John S. McCain NDAA FY2019 is stated in Part VI but not coded as a relation.
